nom: PEACH & LILY Power Cocktail Lactic Acid Repair Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum controls hormonal breakouts and does not leave skin greasy or shiny.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter-dry and very dry skin, report the serum feels hydrating and does not strip or flake their skin, unlike other exfoliants they tried.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it balancing both oiliness and dryness while addressing enlarged pores and closed comedones.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive or reactive (including rosacea-prone) skin frequently report they can tolerate this lactic acid where other acids caused instant redness, though a couple mention mild redness or dryness early on.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-60s report smoother texture, softened lines, and a healthier glow, with several calling it a staple for mature or 'senior' skin.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers citing fine lines, wrinkles, or crow's feet report visibly smoother, less wrinkled skin over weeks to months; one reviewer of three-plus bottles reports no improvement in lines despite brighter complexion.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe skin as more hydrated, plump, and less flaky after use, including those who previously found exfoliants drying; no reports of worsened dryness beyond initial adjustment.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including those with rosacea, report reduced redness and no irritation after use; one reviewer reports the product itself sometimes makes her face red and dry.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer recovering from a damaged skin barrier reports this serum was gentle enough to use without disrupting healing and helped manage congestion.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and sun damage report fading and more even tone over weeks, though a couple say it is too early to judge results.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne, hormonal breakouts, or closed comedones report fewer new breakouts, faster healing, and fading scars; one reviewer with cystic/hormonal acne on the chest reports it as the only product that stops breakouts, while another notes it is not preventative and won't stop breakouts before they appear.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum does not leave skin greasy and helps balance oil production alongside acne concerns.

aspects.libelle: Tingling or stinging sensation on application
Skin feels soft and smooth next day
Pairs well with other Peach & Lily products

extraits.texte: About to start my 3rd bottle. Has not helped lines at all. Complexion does seem brighter. Sometimes it makes my face red and dry. Probably will mot re-purchase
This makes my 54 year old dry winter skin feel fresh and supple. I immediately noticed a difference the first time I used this. This is my second bottle. Don't hesitate.

I can not use even 5% lactic or glycolic serum on my cheek—instant redness. The only acid that I can both tolerate and get any results from is salicylic. Got a sample packet of this, planning to only use on a stubborn closed comedone on forehead (hasn't budged after a handful of uses). The first time I've been able to use LA without irritation (dry, rosacea). In the morning skin was overall noticeably brighter and more even, and an area that was lightly discolored was cleared (!). Tingled for 5-10 min, but very bearable. I layered over GS serum and under moisturizer. Similar results to image ageless masque with less effort.

extraits.titre: Amazing serum for acne on sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I don't write reviews often, but Peach and Lily is a brand that I find myself continuing to come back to — I have sensitive skin with a lot of texture and acne issues as well as blackheads and clogged pores — especially on my cheeks and nose. This serum has no fragrance and doesn't irritate my skin beyond a slight tingle (which is to be expected with acid serums). It has visibly cleared multiple blackheads I had on my cheeks after one use. I'll be buying another bottle once I run out. Peach and Lily's products all do wonders on my skin and they're quickly becoming my favorite!!

I love this product, and the price point is workable for me. Over two years ago I destroyed my skin barrier by doing way too much with high strength products (retinol, salicylic acid, vitamin c serum, exfoliants) and got a chemical burn. After babying my skin back to health for 6 months, I wanted a gentle exfoliation. This is perfect! I have dry skin that's prone to congestion if I don't exfoliate, and this has kept congestion at bay. I used to use a ton of masks and pore strips to compensate, and now maybe use those around my cycle once a month. My dry skin is glowing!

I have combination skin and this repair serum addresses it all. The dryness, the oiliness, the enlarged pores and the debris- it's all balanced and leveled out so my skin can look smooth and clear. Aside from it smelling a bit unpleasant, a little goes a long way so you're not slathering it on and smelling it all day. Especially if you layer it with the glass skin serum and a moisturizer. I love this serum and it has done so much good for my skin. Whenever I run out, it's a sad time until I get it again

Don't use this the way that I did on my first bottle, it is not going to cure acne before it shows up, it's not preventative. But once you have a breakout, especially if you maybe, I don't know, picked at it,l this is the product to calm things down. By the next day it has decreased redness and helped get your skin well on the way to healing.
